name: Syaandi Blood Glutton (CR 5)
body:
Syaandi Blood Glutton
CR 5

XP 1,600
Male syaandi warpriest 6
CN Medium humanoid (reptilian)
Init +5; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +1

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 12, flat-footed 17 (+6 armor, +1 Dex, +1 dodge, +1 natural)
hp 49 (6d8+18)
Fort +6, Ref +3, Will +7; +2 vs. fear, +2 vs. poison, spells, and spell-like abilities
Defensive Abilities cornered fury, fearless, hardy

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +1 keen bardiche +9 (1d8+5/17-20)
Ranged double-barreled pistol +5 (1d8/x4)
Special Attacks blessings 6/day, channel negative energy 2/day (DC 14, 3d6), ferocity, fervor 4/day (2d6), sacred weapon (+1, 1d8, 6 rounds/day)
Warpriest Spells Prepared (CL 6th; concentration +8)

2nd—disfiguring touch (DC 14), hold person (DC 14), instrument of agony (DC 14), weapon of awe
1st—bane (DC 13), cause fear (DC 13), doom (DC 12), protection from law, ray of sickening (DC 13)
0 (at will)—create water, detect magic, purify food and drink (DC 11), read magic, spark (DC 12)

TACTICS

Before Combat A syaandi blood glutton keeps his distance between himself and his warriors, channeling negative energy to damage his opponents. Thereafter, he makes Power Attacks using Furious Focus with his longspear, activating his sacred weapon ability to enhance it with the keen weapon property as a swift action and with weapon of awe if he has the chance.

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 13, Con 12, Int 8, Wis 14, Cha 12
Base Atk +4; CMB +7; CMD 18 (18 vs. sunder)
Feats Cleave, Dodge, Furious Focus, Improved Initiative, Power Attack, Weapon Focus (longspear)
Skills Heal +5, Intimidate +7, Survival +6
Languages Syaandu
SQ blessings (strength: strength surge, war: war mind), cornered fury, unintelligible
Combat Gear potion of cure moderate wounds, potion of remove fear, scroll of silence (DC 13, CL 3); Other Gear +1 chag plate, +1 longspear, double-barreled pistol with 10 metal cartridges, tear shard, 45 gp
